cards.ex: The detective suspected the suspect had tried to falsify evidence at the crime scene.
cards.exUz: Detektiv gumondor jinoyat joyida dalillarni soxtalashtirishga uringan deb gumon qildi.
cards.uzDef: Dalillarni o'zgartirib, yolg'on ko'rsatishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The police believe the robbery was an inside job, given how easily the thieves bypassed security.
cards.exUz: Politsiya o'g'irlik ichki ish ekanligiga ishonadi, chunki o'g'rilar xavfsizlikni qanday osonlik bilan chetlab o'tishdi.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyat, tashkilot ichidagi odamlar tomonidan qilingan.

cards.ex: I saw a sketchy character lurking near the bank yesterday.
cards.exUz: Men kecha bank yaqinida shubhali odamni ko'rdim.
cards.uzDef: Ishonchsiz, g'alati va shubhali ko'rinadigan odam.

cards.ex: His family refused to bail him out, hoping he'd learn his lesson.
cards.exUz: Uning oilasi unga saboq bo'lishini umid qilib, uni garovga qo'yishdan bosh tortdi.
cards.uzDef: Qamoqdan ozod qilish uchun garov puli to'lash.

cards.ex: She decided to hand in the evidence anonymously, fearing retaliation.
cards.exUz: U qasos olishdan qo'rqib, dalillarni anonim tarzda topshirishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Dalillarni rasmiy ravishda politsiya yoki sudga topshirish.

cards.ex: The suspect waived his rights and confessed to the crime.
cards.exUz: Gumondor o'z huquqlaridan voz kechdi va jinoyatni tan oldi.
cards.uzDef: Konstitutsiyada berilgan huquqlardan ixtiyoriy ravishda voz kechish.

cards.ex: The lawyer objected to the leading question during the cross-examination.
cards.exUz: Advokat so'roq paytida yo'naltiruvchi savolga e'tiroz bildirdi.
cards.uzDef: Javob beruvchini ma'lum javobga undaydigan savol.

cards.ex: The evidence was cut and dried; there was no doubt about his guilt.
cards.exUz: Dalillar aniq va yakuniy edi; uning aybi haqida hech qanday shubha yo'q edi.
cards.uzDef: Aniqlangan va bahslarga o'rin qoldirmaydigan.

cards.ex: He was released early on good behavior.
cards.exUz: U yaxshi xulq-atvori tufayli erta ozod qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Ozodlikda bo'lish sharti bilan yaxshi xulq-atvorda bo'lish.

cards.ex: It's unbelievable that he got off scot-free after all that he did.
cards.exUz: U qilgan ishlari uchun jazosiz qutulgani aqlga sig'maydi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday jazo olmasdan qutulib qolish.

cards.ex: He threw his accomplice under the bus to avoid a longer sentence.
cards.exUz: U uzoqroq muddatga hukm qilinmaslik uchun sherigini sotdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z manfaatini ko'zlab, boshqani ayblash.

cards.ex: The defense argued that the gun was planted evidence.
cards.exUz: Himoya qurolning soxta dalil ekanligini ta'kidladi.
cards.uzDef: Aybsiz odamni aybdor qilish uchun soxta dalil qo'yish.

cards.ex: Someone had tampered with the crime scene, making the investigation harder.
cards.exUz: Kimdir jinoyat joyini buzgan, bu tergovni qiyinlashtirgan.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsani yashirincha o'zgartirish, odatda noqonuniy maqsadlarda.

cards.ex: The evidence was dismissed as mere hearsay.
cards.exUz: Dalil shunchaki mish-mish sifatida rad etildi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa odamlardan eshitilgan ma'lumot, isbot emas.

cards.ex: The police force closed ranks after the scandal broke.
cards.exUz: Janjal boshlanganidan keyin politsiya kuchlari birlashdi.
cards.uzDef: Tanqid yoki hujumga qarshi birgalikda himoya qilish.

cards.ex: He faces a charge of fraud.
cards.exUz: U firibgarlik aybloviga duch kelmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy ayblovga javob berishga majbur bo'lish.

cards.ex: The police found a trove of evidence in the suspect's apartment.
cards.exUz: Politsiya gumondorning kvartirasida ko'p miqdordagi muhim dalillar topdi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p miqdordagi muhim dalillar to'plami.

cards.ex: The investigators decided to follow the money to uncover the money laundering scheme.
cards.exUz: Tergovchilar pul yuvish sxemasini aniqlash uchun pulni kuzatishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyat izini topish uchun pul oqimini kuzatish.

cards.ex: It was a no-brainer that he was guilty given the amount of evidence.
cards.exUz: Dalillar miqdorini hisobga olsak, u aybdor ekanligi juda oson edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda oson yechimga ega bo'lgan muammo.

cards.ex: The officer has been on the beat for ten years.
cards.exUz: Ofitser o'n yildirki patrulda.
cards.uzDef: Politsiyachining o'z hududida patrullik qilishi.

cards.ex: He's finally in the clear after the investigation cleared him.
cards.exUz: Tergov uni oqlaganidan keyin u nihoyat xavfsiz.
cards.uzDef: Shubha ostida emaslik yoki ayblovdan ozod bo'lish.

cards.ex: The investigation uncovered a web of deceit surrounding the corrupt politician.
cards.exUz: Tergov korruptsiyalashgan siyosatchi atrofidagi yolg'on to'rini ochib berdi.
cards.uzDef: Murakkab yolg'on va aldov tizimi.

cards.ex: He got off lightly with just a fine.
cards.exUz: U faqat jarima bilan yengil jazolandi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilganidan ko'ra yengilroq jazo olish.

cards.ex: The detective finally cracked the case after months of investigation.
cards.exUz: Detektiv bir necha oylik tergovdan keyin nihoyat ishni ochdi.
cards.uzDef: Murakkab jinoyatni yechish.

cards.ex: The prosecution painted him as a stone-cold killer.
cards.exUz: Prokuratura uni rahm-shafqatsiz qotil sifatida tasvirladi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday his-tuyg'usiz odam o'ldiradigan shaxs.

cards.ex: He decided to turn state's evidence to avoid a life sentence.
cards.exUz: U umrbod qamoq jazosidan qutulish uchun davlatga guvohlik berishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa ayblanuvchilarga qarshi guvohlik berib, jazo muddatini kamaytirish.

cards.ex: The judge criticized the lawyer's questioning as a mere fishing expedition.
cards.exUz: Sudya advokatning savollarini shunchaki maqsadsiz qidiruv deb tanqid qildi.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumot topish maqsadida puxta rejasiz tergov.

cards.ex: The corruption scandal was swept under the rug to protect the mayor's reputation.
cards.exUz: Korruptsiya janjali hokimning obro'sini himoya qilish uchun yashirib ketildi.
cards.uzDef: Muammo e'tibordan chetda qoldirilib, yashirilmoq.

cards.ex: After years on the run, he will finally face justice.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yillar qochqinda bo'lganidan keyin u nihoyat adolat oldida javob beradi.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyat uchun sudlanmoq va jazolanmoq.

cards.ex: Even overseas, he couldn't escape the long arm of the law.
cards.exUz: Chet elda ham u qonunning uzoq qo'lidan qochib qutula olmadi.
cards.uzDef: Hukumatning yoki qonunning ta'siri, qayerda bo'lishidan qat'i nazar.
